grounds.desert: Sun-baked desert ruins: warm sandstone tiles on top, broken carved pillars along the back edge, a few teal glazed tiles and gold ornaments, small sand drifts over the stones.
grounds.forge: A dwarven forge: dark iron and stone floor plates with rivets on top, an anvil and a small chimney furnace along the back edge, glowing orange lava cracks in the rock below.
grounds.neon: A cyberpunk rooftop: black metal grating and concrete on top, air vents, cables and a small glowing cyan and magenta neon sign along the back edge, rusty pipes underneath.
grounds.forest: An ancient mossy forest outcrop: soft green moss and grass on top, twisted roots, small glowing mushrooms and ferns along the back edge, mossy grey rock below.
grounds.ice: A frozen citadel terrace: pale blue ice and white marble tiles on top, sharp ice crystals and a broken silver railing along the back edge, frosted rock below.

backs.desert: An endless golden desert at sunset with distant ruined temples and giant sandstone arches, warm haze and drifting dust, teal sky fading to orange.
backs.forge: A vast underground dwarven forge hall with towering stone columns, rivers of glowing lava, chains and giant gears in the distance, warm orange light and smoke.
backs.neon: A rainy cyberpunk city at night with tall skyscrapers covered in cyan and magenta neon signs, flying cars and holograms in the distance, purple fog.
backs.forest: An ancient enchanted forest with giant mossy trees, glowing green spores and light shafts through the canopy, soft mist.
backs.ice: A frozen mountain kingdom with an ice citadel on distant peaks, an aurora in a deep blue night sky, falling snow and pale moonlight.

weapons.kaya_dagger: A curved desert dagger with a polished steel crescent blade, a gold crossguard and a handle wrapped in teal cloth with a gold pommel.

weapons.volt_blade: A futuristic cyberpunk short sword with a black high-tech handle and a sleek blade with a glowing cyan energy edge and small magenta lights.
weapons.wren_bow: An elegant wooden longbow made of curved dark wood with green leaves growing along it, a softly glowing green rune at the grip and a thin bowstring.
weapons.frostine_staff: A tall silver mage staff topped with a large glowing pale blue ice crystal held by silver prongs, with small ice shards along the shaft.
